summary: Nutrien Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching an October 5, 2026 news release announcing the indefinite shutdown of its Trinidad Nitrogen operations at the Point Lisas Facility after an extensive review of strategic alternatives and stakeholder engagement. No price, stake, or transaction terms were disclosed. Management cited persistent natural gas constraints, port access restrictions, and weak free cash flow contribution; the facility was already under controlled shutdown since October 23, 2025. Nutrien reaffirmed 2026 nitrogen sales volume guidance, assumed no Trinidad production, and will supply customers from North American nitrogen assets. This is an operational restructuring/exit, not a securities event; watch for impairment charges, severance costs, asset-sale potential, and any impact on nitrogen pricing or free cash flow guidance.
